target.title: [codex] docs(cli): align transcription fallback order
target.body:
## Summary

- Align `summarize transcriber setup` output with the current automatic transcription order, including Deepgram.
- Reword `--transcriber` docs/help so it is described as selecting the local transcription stage, not overriding Groq globally.
- Update README and mode docs to consistently describe the runtime order: Groq first when keyed, then local ONNX/`whisper.cpp`, then AssemblyAI, Gemini, OpenAI, FAL, and Deepgram.
- Document Gemini and Deepgram transcription model override env vars where provider keys are listed.

## Why

Deepgram was added to the remote fallback chain, but the setup output still ended at FAL. Several docs also still implied local `whisper.cpp` or ONNX was preferred before Groq, and some wording made `--transcriber` sound like a hard provider override even though Groq still runs first when configured.

## Behavior proof

`pnpm -s summarize --help | sed -n '/--transcriber <name>/,+5p'`

```text
--transcriber <name>              Local transcription stage: auto (default),
                                  whisper, parakeet, canary; Groq still runs
                                  first when keyed (choices: "auto",
                                  "whisper", "parakeet", "canary")
--diarize [provider]              Add speaker labels to YouTube or direct
                                  audio/video: auto (ElevenLabs then OpenAI),
```

`pnpm -s summarize transcriber help`

```text
Usage: summarize transcriber setup [--model parakeet|canary] [--theme <name>]

Configures local ONNX transcription by printing the required env vars.
Auto selection: Groq -> ONNX (selected/configured parakeet or canary) -> whisper.cpp -> AssemblyAI -> Gemini -> OpenAI -> FAL -> Deepgram.

Options:
  --model <name>   parakeet (default) or canary
  --theme <name>   aurora, ember, moss, mono

Examples:
  summarize transcriber setup
  summarize transcriber setup --model canary
```

`pnpm -s summarize transcriber setup | sed -n '1,16p'`

```text
Transcriber setup
Transcriber mode: auto
Auto order: Groq -> ONNX (selected/configured parakeet or canary) -> whisper.cpp -> AssemblyAI -> Gemini -> OpenAI -> FAL -> Deepgram

ONNX parakeet: not configured (SUMMARIZE_ONNX_PARAKEET_CMD)
ONNX canary: not configured (SUMMARIZE_ONNX_CANARY_CMD)
ONNX cache: /Users/vincent/.cache/summarize/onnx
ONNX parakeet artifacts: missing

whisper.cpp: binary missing (whisper-cli)
whisper.cpp model: missing (/Users/vincent/.summarize/cache/whisper-cpp/models/ggml-base.bin)

To enable ONNX locally:
  Install sherpa-onnx from upstream binaries or build; Homebrew may not have a formula.
  export SUMMARIZE_ONNX_PARAKEET_CMD='["sherpa-onnx", "--tokens", "{vocab}", "--offline-ctc-model", "{model}", "--input-wav", "{input}"]'
  # placeholders: {input}, {model}, {vocab}, {model_dir} (see docs/nvidia-onnx-transcription.md)
```

## Validation

- `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`
- `pnpm exec vitest run tests/transcriber-cli.test.ts tests/cli.help.test.ts tests/transcription.whisper.cloud-providers.test.ts tests/transcription-start.test.ts tests/package-bin.test.ts`
- `pnpm -s typecheck`
- `pnpm -s check`

## CI note

GitHub `test (24)`, Firefox extension smoke, and GitGuardian passed on PR #344. The `extension-e2e` job failed before dependency install/tests during `corepack prepare pnpm@10.33.2 --activate` on the Node 24.18.0 runner with a Node/undici assertion (`assert(!this.paused)`).
